title: Studios
intro: Every station on the platform. Each studio broadcasts in one language, and the language picker decides which studio people hear.
actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

create.title: New studio
create.languageHint: The studio broadcasts in this language. It can't be changed later.
create.ownerHint: Optional. You can also add people later from the studio's settings.
create.permanentHint: The studio uses the platform audio format (bitrate, sample rate, channels) so tracks and live shows play back smoothly. Its media folder and encoder credentials are created for you.
create.done: {{name}} is on air. Upload music and share the encoder credentials to start broadcasting.
create.noneAvailable: Every supported language already has a studio.
create.pending: {{name}} was created. The stream server couldn't confirm it yet; it comes on air within 5 minutes.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: The stream goes off air right away and current listeners move to the default studio. Members lose access until it is reactivated. Music, members and statistics are kept.
deactivate.pending: {{name}} was deactivated. The stream server couldn't confirm it yet; it goes off air within 5 minutes.

activate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
activate.body: The stream comes back on air right away with its music, members and settings as they were.
activate.pending: {{name}} was reactivated. The stream server couldn't confirm it yet; it comes on air within 5 minutes.
